verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm docs.x.ai serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200). That file indexes the full Grok Build docs section and documents a markdown-mirror convention (append .md or send Accept: text/markdown). A keyless GET of the Grok Build overview .md returned clean markdown, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for this product. The .md.md 404 only reflects a doubled extension and is not a failure. Missing for 10: a Grok Build-specific llms.txt (the file is site-wide xAI docs) and independent community corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.x.ai/llms.txt # SpaceXAI API Documentation
docs.x.ai's llms.txt documents the convention (append .md, or send Accept: text/markdown) and indexes the full Grok Build docs section.
